deficiencies.description: The text states that looking at the endocervical canal means looking at the cervix ('this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here'). It does not state that the cervix is seen alongside the endocervical canal.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Histologically, this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and the cervix is seen alongside it

deficiencies.description: The lecturer hedged the statement about which women are dying of cervical cancer using 'would be', but the rewrite removes the hedge by stating categorically that they 'are' those women.
